<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 512 512" width="512" height="512" style="color:#111">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="grad1" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#0066FF"/>
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#00AAFF"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <clipPath id="clip-circle">
      <circle cx="256" cy="256" r="140"/>
    </clipPath>
  </defs>
  
  
  
  <!-- 外圆环 - "边界" -->
  <circle cx="256" cy="256" r="160" fill="none" stroke="url(#grad1)" stroke-width="8"/>
  <circle cx="256" cy="256" r="140" fill="none" stroke="url(#grad1)" stroke-width="3"/>
  
  <!-- 内部：Agent 核心点 -->
  <circle cx="220" cy="256" r="24" fill="url(#grad1)"/>
  
  <!-- "穿越"弧线 — 从核心出发，穿过圆环边界，延伸到外面 -->
  <path d="M 230 256 Q 320 180, 420 200" fill="none" stroke="url(#grad1)" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M 230 256 Q 320 256, 420 256" fill="none" stroke="url(#grad1)" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M 230 256 Q 320 330, 420 312" fill="none" stroke="url(#grad1)" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- 目标点：穿越后的落脚 -->
  <circle cx="420" cy="200" r="8" fill="#00AAFF"/>
  <circle cx="420" cy="256" r="8" fill="#00AAFF"/>
  <circle cx="420" cy="312" r="8" fill="#00AAFF"/>
</svg>
